charts.title: TOI-1136 e: orbits around TOI-1136
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1136's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1136 e highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 18.79554696537 d

charts.title: TOI-1136 e: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1136 e crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (41, 48, 75) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 142276270, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 28 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 31 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 28 min late; 18-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 10 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
